Problem: Random variable (X,Y) density f(x,y)=2 for 0<x<y,0<y<1; 0 otherwise. Find for 0<y<1, f_{X|Y}(x|y)=____.
Options:
A. cases 1/x, 0<y<x, 0 other (weird condition)
B. {1/(2x), |y|<x, 0 other}
C. 1/y, 0<x<y, 0 other
D. 1/(2y), |x|<y, 0 other.

We need conditional density of X given Y=y. For 0<y<1, marginal f_Y(y)=∫_{x=0}^{y} 2 dx = 2y. Then f_{X|Y}(x|y)= f(x,y)/f_Y(y) = 2/(2y)=1/y for 0<x<y. So C.
Check options: C exactly 1/y 0<x<y. D says 1/(2y), |x|<y; not correct. A B not. So answer C.

\[
f_{X|Y}(x|y)=\frac{f(x,y)}{f_Y(y)}
\]

其中当 \(0<y<1\) 时，

\[
f_Y(y)=\int_0^y 2\,dx=2y
\]

因此

\[
f_{X|Y}(x|y)=\frac{2}{2y}=\frac{1}{y},\quad 0<x<y
\]

答案为 C。
